cover.alt: ITTI Announces New Registration for January–March 2026 Intake

html:
International Travel and Tourism Institute (ITTI) has opened registration for its January–March 2026 intake. Prospective students are advised to review the available programmes by visiting the Academics section and enroll in their preferred course accordingly.

The institute operates from 08:00 hours to 17:00 hours, Monday to Friday, and encourages interested applicants to complete their registration within the stipulated period.

This announcement was issued on December 17, 2025, as part of ITTI’s ongoing commitment to providing accessible and structured professional training in travel, tourism, and aviation.
